   - Use 1 gray dye and 1 white wool to make 1 gray wool.

   - Use 2 gray wool to make 1 gray carpet; repeat this process 3 more times.

This sequence ensures that all necessary items are gathered and combined correctly to achieve the goal of crafting a gray bed.
